=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:593 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The consumer retro fan-out step falls back to `github.token`, which is repo-scoped and cannot write to consumer repositories.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers report that every cross-repo write attempt will fail without a GH_PAT, making the weekly-retro job fail when consumers are processed.
- scripts/workflow_retro_fanout.sh:298 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The tracker comment upsert only fetches the first page of comments, so an existing week-marker comment on a later page can be missed and duplicated.
  WHY: Reviewers consistently note the `per_page=100` fetch lacks pagination, which breaks deduplication on busy tracker issues.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:317 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The no-activity gate only skips when `WORKFLOW_RETRO_SKIP_IF_NO_ACTIVITY` is exactly `"true"`, so other boolean-ish values are ignored.
  WHY: Reviewers say this diverges from the repo’s broader boolean convention and can cause unnecessary retro runs.
- scripts/workflow_retro_fanout.sh:281-284 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The `gh issue reopen` and `gh issue edit` calls in `run_consumer_retro` are unguarded, so their failures may not mark the repo fan-out as failed.
  WHY: One reviewer flagged that the surrounding `if ! run_consumer_retro ...` context can suppress `set -e` behavior inside the function.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The consumer retro fan-out needs cross-repo issue write permissions; falling back to `github.token` will predictably fail against consumer repos.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml consumer retro fan-out step
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  EVIDENCE: No gate on `GH_PAT` presence; `GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT || github.token }}` remains in the fan-out step and cannot work for cross-repo writes.
- requirement: The no-activity gate only skips when `WORKFLOW_RETRO_SKIP_IF_NO_ACTIVITY` is exactly the string `"true"`.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml line 317
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  EVIDENCE: The step still compares `${WORKFLOW_RETRO_SKIP_IF_NO_ACTIVITY:-true}` to exact `"true"` instead of accepting the repo’s broader boolean forms.
- requirement: Add explicit `|| return 1` guards so a failed reopen/label edit correctly marks the repo fan-out as failed.
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_retro_fanout.sh lines 281-284
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  EVIDENCE: `gh issue reopen` and `gh issue edit` in `run_consumer_retro` lack error guards.
- requirement: The gate now also skips ai:security-audit / ai:retro labels, mirroring internal-clarify.yml (§12.B production-noise defect introduced by this rollout, fixed in the same PR).
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/internal-clarify.yml
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  EVIDENCE: No modification to `.github/workflows/internal-clarify.yml`; only `.github/workflows/clarify.yml` was changed.
- requirement: Consumer clarify recursion guard — consumer repos with ai:security-audit / ai:retro labels should not trigger clarify runs.
  expected_change_site: workflow-level guarantee for consumer clarify runs or test coverage proving the gate works
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  EVIDENCE: No consumer-clarify guard in `.github/workflows/*.yml` beyond `.github/workflows/clarify.yml`, and `tests/test_security_audit_workflow_contract.py` only exercises the source-repo clarify recursion guard.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- `.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml`
  Line or code reference: line 593
  Problem: The consumer fan-out step always runs with `GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT || github.token }}`, but `github.token` cannot write to consumer repositories.
  Why it fails at runtime: When GH_PAT is absent or lacks cross-repo scope, every consumer write attempt fails and the weekly-retro job is marked failed.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- `scripts/workflow_retro_fanout.sh`
  Line or code reference: line 298
  Problem: The week-marker upsert only fetches the first page of tracker comments, so an existing comment on a later page can be missed.
  Why it fails at runtime: Busy tracker issues with more than 100 comments can produce duplicate comments instead of updating the existing one.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: "Consumer clarify recursion guard" — consumer repos with ai:security-audit / ai:retro labels should not trigger clarify runs.
  Expected change site: workflow-level guarantee for consumer clarify runs OR test coverage proving the gate works (e.g., tests/consumer_clarify_recursion_test.yml)
  Evidence of absence: PR diff shows no consumer-clarify guard in `.github/workflows/*.yml` beyond `.github/workflows/clarify.yml`, and `tests/test_security_audit_workflow_contract.py` only tests source-repo clarify recursion.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- File: `.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml`
  Line or code reference: line 593 (consumer retro fan-out step)
  Problem: The step uses `GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT || github.token }}` for cross-repo issue writes, but `github.token` is repo-scoped and cannot write to consumer repositories.
  Why it fails at runtime: Without GH_PAT, every consumer API call fails with 403/404, each repo is logged as failed, and the weekly-retro job exits 1 when all consumers fail.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: `.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml`
  Line or code reference: line 317 (no-activity gate)
  Problem: The gate tests `WORKFLOW_RETRO_SKIP_IF_NO_ACTIVITY:-true` for the exact string `"true"`, so boolean-ish values like `1` or `True` are ignored.
  Why it fails at runtime: Configurations that should skip no-activity weeks are missed, causing unnecessary Codex invocations and cost.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: `scripts/workflow_retro_fanout.sh`
  Line or code reference: lines 281-284 (gh issue reopen / gh issue edit inside run_consumer_retro)
  Problem: The `gh issue reopen` and `gh issue edit` calls are unguarded.
  Why it fails at runtime: If reopen or label-edit fails, the script may continue as though the repo succeeded instead of marking it failed.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: "The consumer retro fan-out needs cross-repo issue write permissions. Falling back to github.token will predictably fail against every consumer repo (repo-scoped token), causing the step (and potentially the weekly job) to fail when all consumers are attempted." (Copilot entry[18])
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml` consumer retro fan-out step
  Evidence of absence: No gate on GH_PAT presence; uses github.token fallback that cannot work for cross-repo writes.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: "The no-activity gate only skips when WORKFLOW_RETRO_SKIP_IF_NO_ACTIVITY is exactly the string 'true'. Elsewhere in the repo, boolean-ish env vars accept 1|true|yes|on (case-insensitive)." (Copilot entry[17])
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml` line 317
  Evidence of absence: String test is = "true" instead of a case-insensitive multi-value check.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: "Add explicit || return 1 guards so a failed reopen/label edit correctly marks the repo fan-out as failed." (Copilot entry[14])
  Expected change site: `scripts/workflow_retro_fanout.sh` lines 281-284
  Evidence of absence: gh issue reopen and gh issue edit calls lack error guards.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
